source: raygui.h v5.0-dev (RAYGUI_VERSION 4.5.0) as shipped in raylib 6.0 examples/*/raygui.h

GuiSetAlpha.scope: guiAlpha clamped to [0, 1]; every control color is faded by it.

GuiSetFont.scope: When the font texture id is above 0, the gui draws and measures its texts with the font (glyph widths, TEXT_SIZE over its base size, DrawTextCodepoint with its texture, MeasureTextEx for tooltips); the gui keeps a Data copy (J.Font.Shared) and the font comes back.
gaps: A copy instead of the struct with shared pointers (language adaptation): each text drawn rebuilds the font from the copy, slower for a large atlas
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiGetFont.scope: GetFontDefault for a new gui, or a font equal to the one GuiSetFont set; Gui.font_base_size is its baseSize.
gaps: An equal font instead of the same struct (language adaptation)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiSetStyle.scope: The 16x24 style table; a DEFAULT base property reaches every control.

GuiLoadStyleDefault.scope: The default style table as raygui fills it (a new Gui holds it).

GuiEnableTooltip.scope: Sets guiTooltip; a new gui starts with tooltips off.
gaps: Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiSetTooltip.scope: The tooltip text (None for NULL). GuiButton, GuiToggle and GuiTextBox (out of edit mode) draw it when focused, unlocked and no control is dragged: a GuiPanel 4 pixels below the control, 16 wider than MeasureTextEx of the text and 8 higher a line (GetTextLines, at most 128), moved left to end at the control right edge where it would pass the screen width and above the control where it would pass its height, the text centered as a GuiLabel without padding.
gaps: raygui keeps the caller pointer; Jongui keeps the text
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiIconText.scope: snprintf "#%03i#" of the id, then the text from the sixth byte (a prefix of six or more bytes loses its last ones); NULL text gives the whole prefix.
gaps: A text of 1019 bytes or more leaves raygui's static buffer unterminated: None
A string result instead of a pointer to a static buffer (language adaptation)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiSetIconScale.scope: The scale of the icons drawn in control texts; a scale below 1 is ignored.
gaps: An icon drawn at a scale above 65536 marks the frame undefined
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiGetIcons.scope: The gui's icon table: 2048 words, eight an icon.
gaps: A list instead of a pointer into the table (language adaptation)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiLoadIcons.scope: Reads an .rgi file (rGI signature, little-endian count and size, 32-byte name ids, then icon count times size*size/32 words, as many as the file holds) over the table from its start; the name ids when asked, else NULL; NULL for a file that does not open or a wrong signature.
gaps: A negative icon count answers undefined (host-dependent fseek and calloc)
Undefined (gui unchanged): a count of words past int range, data past the 2048-word table, a file that ends inside the count, the size or a word
The name ids are lists of 32 bytes instead of allocated strings (language adaptation)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiDrawIcon.scope: One GuiDrawRectangle of pixelSize square for each set bit of the icon in the gui's table (GuiLoadIcons changes it), at C int offsets, faded by guiAlpha.
gaps: An id outside 0..255 (raygui reads past its table) and coordinates that may leave int range (|x| or |y| at 2^30 or more, |pixelSize| at 2^26 or more) mark the frame undefined
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified

GuiGetTextWidth.scope: The first line with the default font, TEXT_SIZE and TEXT_SPACING, as a C int; a text starting with '#' with another '#' in its next four bytes is measured from the second one plus 20, as raygui does.
gaps: The default font only (GuiSetFont is not delivered)
Tooltips are not delivered (off by default)
Targets: CPU-1, CPU-2 and JavaScript lanes; the Metal lane is not verified
